crossRefs.note: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for…
“ ‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
crossRefs.keyword: they shall be your bondmen for ever. Heb. ye shall serveyourselves with them

crossRefs.note: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.
translations.bsb: You may leave them to your sons after you to inherit as property; you can make them slaves for life. But as for your brothers, the Israelites, no man may rule harshly over his brother.
translations.kjv: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
translations.asv: And ye shall make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them shall ye take your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel ye shall not rule, one over another, with rigor.
